P0 — sum of the fine per-peril developed bases at level 1 (no emerging-fitted shrinkage) vs. the single total-cost base, since for buildings/contents (and motor's fine-split "other" perils) each `base_<peril>` is its own independent refit, not an algebraic share of `base`.

Backlog P2 — peril_levels(k=100) on motor only, since P1's loss (0.13820 < kept P0 0.13778) came from letting every peril move, including buildings fire which the backlog flags as noisy; motor glass/hail is the one clearly shifted peril (O6: 1.6-1.8x developed frequency).
